steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Verse literature exams test translation, analysis of poetic features, and evaluation of themes and characterisation — always with reference to the Latin text. | Key Fact: When analysing style, always PEA: Point (name the feature), Evidence (quote the Latin), Analysis (explain the effect on the reader). | Key Fact: Common poetic features to discuss: alliteration, enjambement, elision, caesura, onomatopoeia, hyperbaton, simile, metaphor, and word order. | Key Fact: For evaluation questions on character or theme, structure your answer with an introduction, 3-4 paragraphs each with a Latin quotation, and a conclusion.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from verse literature exam technique, and one past-paper question.
